title: Woman Refuses To Leave Man's Home After One-Night Stand
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On December 24th, 2022. An officer responded to a 911 call regarding a female that was throwing bricks into a man’s home . The woman seemed to be upset about something the man might’ve done. After speaking with the man, it was discovered that he had slept with her previously and never spoke to her again but she showed up at his house angry & refusing to leave. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
